subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, job-level override fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, session/provider precedence, persistence, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not pick the API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Add `payload.model` to `systemEvent` cron payloads with explicit provider/model validation and direct proof for wake-now and next-heartbeat main-session routing.

options.title: Add job-level override fields
options.body: Introduce top-level model/provider or `sessionOverride` fields that apply across payload kinds, accepting the broader schema and docs surface.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` and heartbeat model configuration as the supported per-job or recurring-model paths and leave main-session system events tied to session state.

recommendation.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
recommendation.body: Add `payload.model` to `systemEvent` cron payloads with explicit provider/model validation and direct proof for wake-now and next-heartbeat main-session routing.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on cron session-target product contracts and adjacent model-routing behavior.
